title: Final Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide a final expression for the ground state energy E_g in terms of B, m_q, and hbar.

title: Correct Constants
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly evaluate the numerical constant in the final energy expression.

title: Trial Function Justification
description: Important Criteria: The student must justify the choice of the trial wave function used in the calculation.

title: Minimization Process
description: Important Criteria: The student should clearly outline the process of minimizing the energy expectation value with respect to the variational parameter.

title: Handling A = 0 Case
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly handle the case when A = 0 and derive the corresponding expressions.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check for consistency of units in the final expressions.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the variational principle.

title: Alternative Methods
description: Optional Criteria: The student may mention alternative methods or approaches to estimate the ground state energy.
